text: No, not all of the 2021 loss was inside the pine plantation. The evidence shows that out of the 81.3 ha of tree-cover loss in 2021, 68.1 ha (83.8%) occurred within the pine plantation (*Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), while 13.2 ha (16.2%) occurred outside the mapped forest area. No loss was recorded in native forest. The loss outside the plantation may have occurred in non-forested areas or areas not classified as planted forest in the MGAP 2021 map.
